purpose: Shared guards and protected-span policies applied before correction candidates can be accepted.

globalGuards.reason: Protected content must not be changed.

globalGuards.condition: candidate may alter negation, modality, tense, aspect, agency, quantifier, comparison, or scope
source and replacement differ only by accepted dialect/style variant
globalGuards.reason: Do not normalize a legitimate variety unless requested.

globalGuards.condition: matched phrase appears in user glossary or domain terminology list
text is quoted and quote-preservation mode is enabled
globalGuards.reason: Do not silently rewrite quoted language.

globalGuards.condition: text is a title, heading, bullet fragment, dialogue fragment, or deliberate creative fragment
globalGuards.reason: Sentence-level grammar assumptions may not apply.

globalGuards.condition: two or more corrections remain plausible
same rule proposes the same edit twice or edits oscillate

dialectNotes: Support configured English variety; do not assume US English.
Store accepted variants and their contexts rather than treating frequency as correctness.
Style-guide preferences are not grammar errors unless the user selects that style.
applicationNotes: Check guards before scoring and again immediately before applying edits.
Guard outcomes should be logged without retaining raw text beyond product policy.
A rule-specific guard can narrow a global guard but must not override protected-span rejection.
